brief: 5 SaaS categories AI agents are killing in 2026 — and what to build instead.

slots.title: 0. The Shift, the signal
slots.body: AI agents are replacing single-purpose SaaS tools with autonomous workflows. Founders building point solutions will face extinction by 2026.

slots.title: 1. CRM, the casualty
slots.body: Manual data entry and static pipelines die when agents auto-log every interaction. Build an AI-native relationship operating system instead.

slots.title: 2. Support, the obsolete
slots.body: Rule-based chatbots and ticket queues collapse against agents that resolve issues end-to-end. Build autonomous resolution infrastructure instead.

slots.title: 3. Scheduling, the victim
slots.body: Link-sharing schedulers fail when agents negotiate times across time zones and priorities. Build an executive agent with context-aware autonomy.

slots.title: 4. Research, the replaced
slots.body: Dashboards requiring human interpretation lose to agents that deliver answers and actions. Build agentic insight generators with source verification.

slots.title: 5. Projects, the dead
slots.body: Static task boards rot when agents autonomously plan, delegate, and ship software. Build self-organizing execution systems with memory.

slots.headline: Build the Agent Layer
slots.subline: Stop building tools AI will swallow. Start building the autonomous infrastructure that replaces them.
